# @sharadox/next-js-configuration-web-library

> One-call next.config for Sharadox-style apps.

- /next-configuration: defineNextConfiguration({ root: new URL("./", import.meta.url), styleLibrary?: "@sharadox/x-web-library", locales?: Locales (from @sharadox/internationalization-web-library), productionDomain?: "example.com", next?: NextConfig })
- Sass loadPaths: node_modules/<styleLibrary>/distribution, src
- redirects (all temporary, never permanent): *.vercel.app → https://<productionDomain>/:path* when productionDomain is set; "/" and addresses without a language → remembered/browser/default locale; then next.redirects()
- experimental.globalNotFound is on (one 404 for addresses outside every route: src/app/global-not-found.tsx); next.experimental can override
- headers: X-Content-Type-Options nosniff, Referrer-Policy strict-origin-when-cross-origin, X-Frame-Options DENY, Permissions-Policy (no camera/mic/geo/payment); then next.headers()
- /domain-redirect: vercelAppRedirect(domain): every *.vercel.app address to the same path on the real domain, temporarily
- /security-header: SECURITY_HEADERS: no MIME sniffing, private referrers, no framing, no powerful features
- License: Sharadox Open Source License 0.1.0
- Sass load path also includes node_modules/@sharadox/style-web-library/distribution (`@use "style-helper"`)
